pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.oneTime: One-time purchase. No subscription, no auto-renewal.
pricing.includesLead: All six skills, delivered as six zip packages — one per skill. Each holds the skill file, its reference documents, a licence and a security notice.
pricing.viaMarketplaceBody: Pay on the Agensi marketplace and download immediately. Agensi is the merchant of record and handles invoicing and refunds for that purchase, under the terms shown at their checkout.
pricing.viaDirectBody: Email us and we invoice you directly. We send your download link within 2 business days of payment. If you would rather not spend part of your refund window waiting, say so in reply and we will hold the link until you ask for it.
pricing.contactBody: Email is our direct support channel. We reply within 2 business days.
pricing.requirements: What you need to run it
pricing.requirementsBody: A desktop computer and a coding agent that reads the SKILL.md format — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and Gemini CLI all do. Everything runs locally; no internet connection is required while the skills run.
buy.title: Buy
buy.lead: TeachFlow Complete Bundle — all six skills, delivered as six zip packages, one per skill.
buy.metaDescription: Buy the TeachFlow Complete Bundle: all six skills for teachers, one payment, no subscription.
buy.ctaNote: Checkout is hosted by Polar. Polar is the merchant of record for this purchase and issues your invoice. We never see or store your card details.
buy.delivery: Your download link is emailed to the address you enter at checkout, as soon as the payment is confirmed.
buy.closed: Direct checkout is not open yet
buy.closedBody: Until it opens, the same bundle is on sale on Agensi, or you can email us and we will invoice you directly.

flow.makes.lesson-workflow: Unit breakdown, lesson plan, slide outline
flow.makes.worksheet-workflow: Three worksheets: student, challenge, answer key (.docx)
home.heroTitle: One textbook unit in. A week of lessons out.
home.heroBody: Six SKILL.md skills that take the pages of one textbook unit and produce the lesson plan, the slides, the listening script and audio, the vocabulary table, three levels of worksheets, and the parent notice — in the language each of them belongs in.
home.metaDescription: Six agent skills that turn one textbook unit into the lesson plan, slides, listening audio, vocabulary table, worksheets and parent notice.
home.samplesBody: One real textbook unit, so you can see what each skill produces before you buy.
home.privacyTitle: Your students' data stays on your computer
home.privacyBody: The skills make no network requests — run them offline and they work the same. Your agent and its model are a separate product with its own data policy.
home.buyBody: All six skills, one payment, no subscription.
samples.title: What each skill produces
samples.lead: One textbook unit in, five files out: slides (.pptx), listening audio (.mp3), a vocabulary table (.xlsx), worksheets (.docx) and a parent notice (.png).
samples.note: Every preview below was rendered by the skills themselves from one textbook unit. The listening audio is downloadable as the .mp3 the skill produces; the other four are shown as images while their downloadable copies are prepared, and no sample contains a student or school name.
